meta.name: Generative Fill (Qwen-Image-2.1)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-2.1 (Alibaba Qwen, 2026-09-20) ships under the Qwen Research License Agreement: research and evaluation use only; commercial use needs a separate agreement with Alibaba. Turn on Allow Research-Only Models in Preferences › AI Integrations to use it.
meta.promptFormat: Edit image 1. Image 2 is a mask of image 1: change only the area that is white in image 2 so that it shows {prompt}. Keep everything outside that area exactly as it is in image 1, with the same lighting, perspective and style.
meta.notes: Node names and settings follow ComfyUI's official 'Image Edit (Qwen Image 2.1)' template (image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit.json): UNETLoader → QwenImage21Cache, CLIPLoader type qwen_image, TextEncodeQwenImage21 (clip, vae, prompt, negative_prompt, resolution 0 = keep the inputs' sizes, the grouped `images` input whose API-format keys are `images.image_1`…`images.image_16`; outputs positive, negative and an EMPTY latent sized to image_1), KSampler euler/simple 25 steps CFG 1 denoise 1, VAEDecode. Qwen-Image-2.1 edits in context (the references enter as latents in the conditioning) and regenerates the whole picture, so masking the latent does not inpaint. Instead the selection mask goes in as image_2 and promptFormat asks for a local edit, which the model card documents ('local edits specified by … separate masks'); PhotoCraft's layer mask then confines the visible change to the selection. The optional prompt-enhancement encoder (qwen3.5_9b_qwen_image_2.1_pe_i2i) is left out.
